instruction: Candid outdoor medium photograph of a couple walking on a park path. On the left, the woman in the long black coat (R1) walks forward in blue jeans, looking down with sunglasses on her head. On the right, the man in the black puffer jacket (R2) walks beside her, looking down in her direction. They hold hands, fingers intertwined, as they stroll. The background consists of sunlit autumn trees. Warm afternoon sunlight bathes the scene, creating soft shadows.
